Testimonials

The strongest validation of our work comes from those who’ve experienced it, here’s what our clients have to say.

Pawan Matade

Founder, DeMatade Trading Solutions

AvancePR functions like an addition to our team members. They provide us with full 360-degree integrated communications assistance, and we are quite happy with the professional guidance they have been providing. The team works hard and prepares and executes our PR in a smart manner. They also manage all of the material on our behalf. We aim to keep our relationship with them for the foreseeable future since we respect their role in helping us achieve new heights.

Abhinav Kalia

Founder, ARC Electric

It’s a pleasure working with Ritika and her team on our media campaigns. I am surprised by how energetic the team of these young girls is in delivering unmatched PR services in the industry. We are associated with them for the media relations of Arc Electric and they have delivered as per their commitment and exceeded our expectations. We look forward to a long association!

Major Prashant Veer Singh

Mentor, ARC Electric

Ritika and her agency were hired to shape the marketing campaign of ARC Electric. Team worked diligently to understand our campaign objectives, deliberating various options, finalizing the way forward, and aligning the right team members to complete deliveries in the agreed time frame. Campaign was well received by the desired audience, and we completely achieved our objectives. If any one considering to hire consultants for formulating and delivering on marketing campaigns across multiple channels, then one must look at Ritika and her young energetic team as top option. We wish them good luck in all their endeavors.

Biswajit Mishra

Co-Founder, Hostbooks

Ritika and the dedicated team at AvancePR excel in their passionate and focused approach to client work by using their broad expertise and media links. We are excited to carry on our mutually beneficial partnership, which has been doing great so far. They stand out from the others because they constantly go above and beyond to assist you. Their commitment to understanding objectives, analysing options, and assembling the finest team produced a fantastic campaign that successfully reached our target audience.

Amit Kumar

Co-Founder & CEO, Ramp Global

I became acquainted with Ritika when she joined our team as an intern. We, as a team, greatly admire her discipline, determination, and dedication. These attributes played a crucial role in setting her apart from others and pursuing her aspiration of becoming an entrepreneur. Presently, she is a valued vendor for us, and I am delighted that we engaged her. She continues to exhibit the same commendable qualities and consistently delivers outstanding results.

Swayam Agarwal

Founder, Aarika Innovation

The team at AvancePR is passionate about each of its clients, and it is made up of motivated professionals and experienced workers. They have strong media connections, which helps their clients gain the required attention from the media and the public. We have so far enjoyed a fruitful cooperation and look forward to continuing it. They frequently offer assistance with tasks outside the scope of their job

Lucky Rohilla

Founder & CEO, Quantel

An essential component of our communications chain has been AvancePR. Our company is the ideal fusion of business-to-business and business-to-consumer, with many verticals vying for a piece of the media pie. Their interdisciplinary and comprehensive strategy has enabled Quantel's greater visibility and more satisfying placement among our target groups.

Samast Ahlawat

Founder & CEO, Prabhubhakti

Meet the Founder

An award-winning entrepreneur recognized by ET 40 Under 40 and ET Women Leaders Awards, Ritika Garg founded Avance PR to redefine how brands communicate and connect.

A communications strategist who began her career at Ogilvy, Ritika brings deep expertise in media relations, corporate communications, and influencer strategy. Under her leadership, Avance PR has grown into one of India’s fastest-emerging strategic communications agencies, trusted by over 100+ brands across technology, education, sustainability, hospitality, finance and other sectors.

Guided by her belief that PR is not just about visibility but credibility, influence, and growth, Ritika continues to lead with innovation, empathy, and a people-first vision.
